Neither — they weigh exactly the same. A kilogram is a unit of mass, so a kilogram of feathers and a kilogram of steel both have the same mass, regardless of the material.

This is a classic riddle designed to trick people into saying "steel" because it sounds denser or more "solid" than feathers. But the trick is that the question specifies the *mass* of each, not the volume or density. Since both are one kilogram, they're equally heavy.
